method.method_draft: Use magnetic field direction plus the wire force law. First read the diagram: the pink I wire lies to the left of the blue 2I wire, so the position of the 2I wire relative to the I wire is +x. The axes show the wires are along y. The current in the I wire is along +y, while the 2I current is along −y, as indicated by the arrows and end symbols. From the text, identify that the force sought is the magnetic force on the 2I wire due to the I wire. Apply the right-hand rule for a long straight wire: for current I in +y, the magnetic field at a point to its +x side points in −z.
